does: Computes the average damage a character can deal, as the AI estimates it: for each spell of its spell book unplaced::EstimateSpellDamage fills the damage list of a context with no target, and the result is the largest sum over the spells divided by a global count; no target, no resistance. RCX the helper, RDX a pointer to the entity, R8 the class descriptions; the float in XMM0.

evidence.says: reads eoc::spell::BookComponent, StatsComponent and ClassesComponent, builds eoc::AttackDesc and calls unplaced::EstimateSpellDamage per spell

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 1 place, GetAverageDamageForCharacter on a cache miss (91 calls against about 48 000 of the cached one)
